THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Microwave Protein Pancake Bowl

Pancakes without the pan: fluffy, 2-minute microwave protein pancake bowl with a split adult PBfit finish (~404 cal / 46g protein) and kid-friendly maple sprinkle option.

YIELD1 serving
TOTAL TIME5 min (2 min cook)
COOK METHODSee method
EST. / SERVING~404 cal | ~46g protein

Ingredients

BASE (PER FULL BOWL)

  • 1 large egg (about 50g)
  • 50g Oikos Triple Zero vanilla nonfat Greek yogurt
  • 1/4 cup (60ml) Fairlife fat-free ultra-filtered milk
  • 1 scoop (31g) PEScience Select Gourmet Vanilla protein powder
  • 35g all-purpose flour
  • 1 tsp baking powder
  • 1 tbsp zero-calorie monk-fruit/erythritol sweetener

ADULT FINISH (1 SERVING)

  • 1 tbsp (8g) PBfit powdered peanut butter
  • 30g Maple Grove Farms low-calorie syrup

KIDS FINISH (2 SERVINGS TOTAL)

  • 2 tbsp (30ml) pure maple syrup (e.g. Kirkland)
  • 1 tsp (about 4g) rainbow sprinkles

Allergens: dairy, egg, gluten, peanut.

Method

  1. 1.WHISK WET BASE. In a microwave-safe bowl with room to rise, whisk the egg, Fairlife milk, and vanilla Greek yogurt until smooth.
  2. 2.COMBINE BATTER. Add flour, vanilla protein powder, baking powder, and sweetener. Stir thoroughly until a smooth, velvety batter forms.
  3. 3.MICROWAVE. Microwave on regular power for 2 minutes until risen, puffy, and fully set in the center.
  4. 4.KIDS' FINISH (OPTIONAL). For kids, top the full bowl with 2 tbsp maple syrup and 1 tsp sprinkles, then divide into two equal portions (247 cal / 21g protein each).
  5. 5.ADULT FINISH. Stir 1 tbsp PBfit into 30g low-calorie syrup until glossy and spoon over the warm adult pancake bowl.

SPLIT PLATE SERVING

Adult: Serve the adult portion as described above.

Kid: Serve the kid portion as described above.

Storage and reheating

Store: Best enjoyed fresh, or cool and store covered in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

Reheat: Microwave for 20-30 seconds to warm through.

Lasts: 3 days refrigerated.

Estimated nutrition

~404 cal | ~46g protein per 1 full adult pancake bowl with PBfit syrup finish.
